[Pedagogy review · Suggestion · extension · pf-5ea755777e]
After p7-q6-e, add: (f) For P=30 and l=6, find w using w=(P−2l)/2. Answer: 9. (g) For the same values, find w using w=P/2−l. Answer: 9. (h) Explain why the two formulas give the same result. Expected answer: Dividing both terms of P−2l by 2 gives P/2−l.

[Pedagogy review · High priority · opening-review · pf-41339a2ab0]
Before p16-information-block, add: 'Write each expression as a single fraction. (a) 1/a−1/b; (b) 2/p−1/q; (c) 1/r−3/s.' Answers: (b−a)/(ab), (2q−p)/(pq), (s−3r)/(rs). Use nonzero denominators and keep the review within one page.
Also affects: p16-example-activity

[Pedagogy review · Suggestion · extension · pf-aadf7db9f3]
After p10-q1-c, add parts: (d) 'When p=12, find q in part a.' Answer: 4. (e) 'When p=12, find both values of q in part b.' Answer: ±√8. (f) 'When p=12, find both values of q in part c.' Answer: ±2. (g) 'Explain why changing the sign of q leaves p unchanged in part c.' Answer: 2²=(−2)²=4, so both give p=12.
